doc: Properties class that holds configuration data relevant for security mechanisms

fields.name: clientId
fields.doc: ID of the used oAuth client.

fields.name: permissionsUri
fields.doc:
URI of the endpoint used for fetching permissions,
 see also {@link KeycloakPermissionsAuthoritiesConverter}.

fields.name: permissionsCacheLifetime
fields.doc:
Timeout for which resolved permissions are cached and reused. Default 60s.
 See {@link KeycloakPermissionsAuthoritiesConverter}

fields.name: permissionsCacheMaxSize
fields.doc: Max number of entries the permissions cache contains.

fields.name: loggingMode
fields.doc:
Logging mode for incoming HTTP requests, see also
 {@link RequestResponseLoggingFilter}

fields.name: loggingIgnoreList
fields.doc:
List of paths to ignore when logging HTTP requests, see also
 {@link RequestResponseLoggingFilter}
